description: Use when the user asks which security headers a live website sends or if it forces HTTPS. Returns the redirects from http:// and https:// and HSTS, CSP, frame protection, Referrer-Policy and cookie flags. Ex: 'Which security headers does example.com miss?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
